page.overview:
What is Summer Glen, California?

Summer Glen, California is a fictional Northern California city in the Halloween series.

The town appears to be average-sized at most, with its own private school known as Hillcrest Academy, which is located on the outskirts of town.

On October 31, 1998, serial killer Michael Myers murdered three people at the academy: two high school students and a teacher. Also, a paramedic was killed in the countryside, not too far away from the school.

In one of the final scenes of Halloween H20, Laurie Strode sends her son John and his girlfriend to the Beckers' house, which is a mile from Hillcrest Academy. This is potentially a nod to the Scream franchise.
